title: Format / Formula
markdown:
##### Format / Formula

• S | E | F = Sign (1 bit) | Exponent (5 bits) | Fraction (10 bits)

  ◦ 共 16 bits；Bias = 15

• Sign Bit (S)：0 - Positive；1 - Negative

• Exponent (E) 指数：E=1–30 Stored Exponent；e=E−15 Real Exponent

• Normalized 规格化：Value = (−1)ˢ × 1.F₂ × 2ᴱ⁻¹⁵；Hidden 1 隐藏的 1 不存入 F
